title: An in vivo gene delivery approach for the isolation of reasonable numbers of type 2 innate lymphoid cells
author: Frech, Knipfer, et al.

steps.title: Prepare plate with ice‑cold PBS
steps.instruction: Place a 24‑well plate on ice and add ice‑cold PBS to each well; keep the plate on ice throughout the procedure.

steps.title: Pre‑warm digestion buffer
steps.instruction: For each mouse, aliquot 1 ml of digestion buffer into an Eppendorf tube and warm the tube to 37 °C.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse
steps.instruction: Euthanize the mouse by CO₂ inhalation or cervical dislocation.

steps.title: Optional blood draw
steps.instruction: If desired, collect blood for later cytokine detection by ELISA.

steps.title: Harvest lymphoid organs
steps.instruction: Excise the mesenteric lymph nodes and spleen, place them in ice‑cold PBS, and keep on ice.

steps.title: Mince tissues in buffer
steps.instruction: Cut the harvested organs into small pieces and transfer them into the pre‑warmed digestion buffer.

steps.title: Digest tissue
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue pieces at 37 °C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Set up cell strainer
steps.instruction: Place a 70 µm cell strainer onto a 50 ml conical tube and pre‑wet the strainer with 5 ml ice‑cold staining buffer.

steps.title: Transfer and further mince
steps.instruction: Move the digested tissue onto the strainer, cut into smaller fragments as needed.

steps.title: Mash tissue through strainer
steps.instruction: Using the plunger of a 3 ml syringe, gently press the tissue through the 70 µm strainer.

steps.title: Rinse strainer
steps.instruction: Rinse the strainer with 10 ml staining buffer to collect remaining cells.

steps.title: Centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Bring the volume to 50 ml with staining buffer, then centrifuge for 10 minutes at 400 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Red blood cell lysis – first step
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 1 ml ACK lysis buffer.

steps.title: Red blood cell lysis – second step
steps.instruction: Add an additional 4 ml ACK buffer (total 5 ml), mix, and incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash after lysis
steps.instruction: Add ice‑cold staining buffer to the tube, then centrifuge 10 minutes at 400 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Discard supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 5 ml staining buffer and pass through a 70 µm strainer; rinse the tube with another 5 ml staining buffer and pass through the same strainer.

steps.title: Count viable cells
steps.instruction: Determine cell number using your preferred counting method.

steps.title: Pellet cells before staining
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the counted cells for 10 minutes at 400 × g, 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Adjust cell concentration
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in staining buffer containing Fc block to a final concentration of 2 × 10⁸ cells/ml; keep on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare 2× antibody mix
steps.instruction: Combine the following antibodies in staining buffer to make a 2× mix (use the listed dilution factor for each):

steps.title: Stain cells with antibody mix
steps.instruction: Add one volume of the 2× antibody mix to each cell sample, mix gently, and incubate for 20 minutes at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash stained cells
steps.instruction: Top up each tube to 50 ml with staining buffer, centrifuge 10 minutes at 400 × g, 4 °C, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Final filtration
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml staining buffer, pass through a 30 µm strainer into a 15 ml conical tube; rinse the tube with 5 ml staining buffer and pass through the same strainer; add staining buffer to the tube and centrifuge 5 minutes at 400 × g, 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare for cell sorting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 2 ml staining buffer and keep on ice; provide the FACS operator with a 15 ml collection tube pre‑filled with 2 ml ILC2 resting medium for each sample.

steps.title: Pre‑warm expansion medium
steps.instruction: Warm ILC2 expansion medium to room temperature before use.

steps.title: Post‑sort centrifugation
steps.instruction: After sorting and purity check, centrifuge the cells for 10 minutes at 400 × g, 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Seed cells for culture
steps.instruction: Plate 0.5 × 10⁶ cells per well in a 24‑well plate containing 1 ml pre‑warmed ILC2 expansion medium.

steps.title: Maintain expanding cultures
steps.instruction: Replace the medium every 36–48 hours and passage the cells whenever they reach higher density.

steps.title: Rest cells before assays
steps.instruction: Two days prior to downstream experiments, switch the culture to ILC2 resting medium and keep for 48 hours.
